prompt: Give one tip for better sleep.
response: Maintaining a consistent bedtime routine can significantly improve the quality of your sleep. Going to bed and waking up at the same time each day helps regulate your body's internal clock, making it easier to fall asleep and stay asleep throughout the night. Try incorporating relaxing activities like reading, taking a warm bath, or practicing gentle yoga into your pre-sleep routine to signal to your body that it's time to wind down.
